schema.name: ncaa-wrestling-bracket
schema.read_me_first: model.bracket_model says which rebuild procedure in SPEC.md applies to this file.

model.description: Full double elimination to 8th: every championship loser except the finals loser enters the consolation bracket.

rounds.C_PIG: consolation pigtail bout (winner enters the consolation sheet)
rounds.C_SF: last consolation round; its winners meet for 3rd
rounds.Final: championship final (winner 1st, loser 2nd in all drawn-consolation models)
rounds.PIG: championship pigtail (play-in) bout; the winner holds the draw line given in entrants
rounds.R32: championship first round of a 32-line draw

result_type_suffix.-OT: overtime of any kind: OT, sudden victory (SV), tiebreaker (TB) or criteria (Cr) - see result_raw

from.line:N: came from draw line N (possibly advancing on byes, which are not rows)
from.entry: first bout for this wrestler (pigtail or bad-point round)

slot_kinds.entry: a wrestler enters the consolation sheet here (he lost in the championship bracket or won a C_PIG bout)
slot_kinds.bout: a consolation bout; wrestler = its winner, match_id = the bout

team_scores.scope: Top ten as printed on the summary page (more than ten rows when teams tie)

notes: lost in the championship bracket but not in the consolation bracket: Chris Notte (133-15)
source_discrepancies: 133: James Kennedy (Illinois) is missing from the championship draw on the sheet but wrestles in the consolations and is in the place box; added as a consolation-only wrestler (his championship-bracket bouts are not recorded)

133 consolation: sheet lists "Bye" in an entry slot but prints "Kennedy 8-3" as that bout's winner; James Kennedy (eligible for the consolations and appearing nowhere else on the sheet) taken as the entrant
157 consolation: source prints "Hynek 14-12"; taken as Aaron Hynes (spelling)

174 consolation: sheet lists "Bye" in an entry slot but prints "Jordan 4-2" as that bout's winner; Raymond Jordan (eligible for the consolations and appearing nowhere else on the sheet) taken as the entrant
184 consolation: source prints "Didion 3-0"; taken as Vincenzo DiDona (spelling)
